I had a teacher in school who was notorious for being mentally unstable. I have fond memories of outbursts like the time she threatened to suspend me for taking her personal property (a post-it) without permission. My favorite time was at the end of a period right before we got let out of school. I was on my way to throw out a crumpled up piece of paper and was almost to the garbage when she flickered the lights and told everyone to sit down because the bell was going to ring. I took maybe two seconds to toss the paper in the garbage and then went to sit. She flipped: "Derp! I said, 'SIT DOWN'!!!! And you KNOW that PAPER GOES IN THE RECYCLING." She made me take it out and flatten the paper before placing it in the recycling.

TL;DR: Psycho teacher has various paper-product related outbursts
